# EMCOR Group, Inc. Announces Agreement To Acquire P1 Construction, LLC


**P1 Construction LLC’s Track Record of Operational Excellence, Advanced Fabrication Capabilities and Long-Standing Customer Relationships Strengthens EMCOR’s Leading Mechanical and Electrical Construction Portfolio**


NORWALK, CONNECTICUT and LENEXA, KANSAS – November 13, 2026 – EMCOR Group, Inc. (“EMCOR” or the “Company”) (NYSE: EME) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire P1 Construction, LLC (“P1 Construction” or “P1”), a leading mechanical and electrical contractor serving high-growth areas across the Midwestern U.S., in an all-cash transaction. Terms were not disclosed.


Founded in 1919 and headquartered in Lenexa, Kansas, P1 Construction is a single-source mechanical and electrical specialty contractor with advanced fabrication capabilities serving a broad range of end markets, including mission critical facilities. Throughout its history, P1 Construction has focused on enhancing the customer experience by bringing facilities to life. For the full year 2026, P1 Construction is expected to generate revenues of between $600 million and $650 million and adjusted EBITDA of approximately $60 million.


“P1 Construction is an excellent fit for EMCOR, combining a long-standing record of performance and culture of construction innovation with a steadfast commitment to safety, quality and operational excellence,” said Tony Guzzi, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of EMCOR. “P1 has built a strong reputation for delivering highly complex projects, including hyperscale data centers, advanced manufacturing facilities, healthcare systems, and other mission-critical infrastructure. P1’s talented teams and expertise in engineering, preconstruction, virtual design and construction, and fabrication will further strengthen EMCOR’s ability to tackle increasingly complex projects and support our customers across critical end markets.”


“For over a century, P1 Construction has been driven by a clear purpose: safely and reliably delivering for our customers and the communities we serve,” said Bruce Belcher, Chief Executive Officer of P1 Construction. “Becoming part of EMCOR marks an exciting new chapter for our company and our people. EMCOR’s scaled resources and expanded capabilities will create new opportunities for our employees and enable us to better serve our customers. We are proud to join an organization that shares our commitment to integrity, investing in our people, and delivering excellence on every project.”


Upon completion of the transaction, P1 Construction will be part of EMCOR’s Mechanical Construction and Facilities Services segment. Bruce Belcher will continue to serve as CEO of P1 Construction with the P1 leadership team remaining in place. P1 Construction will remain headquartered in Lenexa, Kansas.


EMCOR expects to fund the transaction through cash on hand. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.


### Advisors


Evercore is serving as financial advisor to EMCOR, Ropes & Gray LLP is serving as its legal advisor, and Joele Frank is serving as its strategic communications advisor. Houlihan Lokey is serving as financial advisor to P1 Construction, and Clark Hill is serving as its legal advisor.

### About P1 Construction


P1 Construction is a mechanical and electrical specialty contractor serving critical infrastructure and blue-chip commercial and industrial customers. P1 Construction offers a comprehensive suite of mission-critical services providing integrated mechanical, electrical, fabrication, and specialty solutions for existing and new facility infrastructure. The company is primarily focused on the manufacturing and industrial and network and communications market sectors, among others.
